name: Visitors Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Visitors permits do not authorise work; a separate work permit is required for employment.

outcome.duration_length: 6 months (CARICOM, UK, Schengen, USA nationals); 3 months (other nationalities); indefinite for OECS nationals

sources.title: Ministry of National Security, Air and Sea Port Development, Government of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines -- Visitors Permit: entry permit durations by nationality (6 months for CARICOM/UK/Schengen/USA, 3 months for other nationalities, indefinite for OECS nationals), extensions at EC$75/month at Immigration Head Office or designated ports (Bequia, Mustique, Canouan, Union Island)

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines' initial build. OECS nationals receive indefinite stay upon entry -- the broadest visitor allowance found for any nationality category across this session's builds. CARICOM citizens holding a CSME Skills Certificate receive 6 months' work authorisation while awaiting an upgraded certificate, per the same source -- not modelled as a separate route here since no further detail was found.
